issues.message: No data-qc-* attributes found; layout QA is using heuristics only.
issues.expected: Explicit data-qc roles and relationships for text boxes, arrows, axes, formulas, and timelines.
issues.recommendation: Add data-qc-role, data-qc-box, data-qc-group, and data-qc-layer to newly generated SVGs.

issues.message: Important elements overlap without an explicit data-qc-allow-overlap exception.

issues.recommendation: Move one element, add wrapping, or mark the intentional overlap with data-qc-allow-overlap="true".
